prompt: Create a square 2x2 atlas of four equal independent character ACTION paintings separated by ivory paper gutters, no labels, no frame. Strict style reference: flat dry matte gouache, broad ochre, charcoal, muted gray-green, simple expressive face marks, visible paper grain, not photorealism or glamorous illustration. New invented HUMAN people Morrowfen (name must NOT appear). Distinct shared physical ancestry: warm light-brown skin with pronounced dark freckles across noses and forearms, tightly coiled dark copper hair, broad blunt noses, strong square chins and rounded eyes under sparse brows. Adults vary in age, face shape and lean robust build, normal full-height bodies and long legs, never little-person proportions, models or heroic poses. Shared invented garments: dark broad cloth band across one shoulder and around waist forming a practical carrying sling over a pale gray short rectangular tunic; separate ochre knee-length loose trousers with side seams tied by cord, no belts with buckles, no identifiable earthly national regalia. TOP LEFT: a middle-aged man with a wide creased face sits high on a low stone stack with BOTH feet braced on lower stones, pulls a load strap tight across a carrying basket as he talks downward to an off-frame helper; overhead three-quarter view. TOP RIGHT: a young lean woman with short dense curls and prominent ears walks toward the viewer at an angle carrying rolled reed mats under one arm while extending the other hand to indicate a place to put them, full legs and feet, no pose to camera. BOTTOM LEFT: an older woman with close gray curls and a broad uneven jaw bends from the hips to sight along a newly placed wooden beam, one eye shut, her palm signaling to someone beyond its far end; side view, sparse building-yard ground. BOTTOM RIGHT: a tall gaunt older man with dark copper-gray cropped hair stands in profile holding a shallow empty clay bowl outward at chest height while explaining a problem, other hand points at a hairline crack in its base; view across a simple low shelf, full gesture visible. Varied angles, no repeated poses or costume swaps of another cast. All main figures and activities fit their cells with generous margin. Earthen surfaces and reed/wood objects only, no advanced buildings, metals, text, weapons or symbols implying civic morality. Ordinary people doing things, no standing portrait lineup.
